We just wrapped Sprint 14 on our inventory management microservice. I need three deliverables before our Monday standup:

1. An engineering health check on the service architecture. We have some notes in `docs/ARCHITECTURE_NOTES.md` — please review them and flag any gaps or risks. Save this as `ENG_REVIEW.md` in the project root.

2. A code review of the handler code in `src/inventory/handlers/inventory_handler.py` and `src/inventory/models/stock_repository.py`. The team says there are some bugs in there. Please fix what can be fixed automatically and document what needs a human decision. Save this as `CODE_REVIEW.md` in the project root.

3. A sprint retrospective based on `docs/sprint14_summary.md`. Save this as `RETRO.md` in the project root.

Please make sure all three documents are thorough and actionable.
